desc: Contemporary, multi-level mall with a limited selection of stores, plus a cinema & food court.
addr: Hosakere Road, opp. Banana Market, Binny Pete, Binnipete, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560023, India

rev.t: People visit this mall only for Cinépolis. It was so deserted. However the colourful rainbow arch looked beautiful. It’s a good spot for taking pictures.

I came here to watch Dhurandhar Movie and became very surprised that all stalls / outlets are closed. Only cinepolis this mall is still operational. Only one food small and no food outlet( for cinepolis stall is there and not much option, only popcorn and nachos)

had an absolutely fantastic experience at this theater! The screen quality is top-notch with crystal-clear projection, and the immersive sound system truly elevates the entire movie-watching experience. The seats are incredibly comfortable …
